mechanism: Rifampin is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inducer that significantly reduces fluoxetine plasma concentrations, potentially diminishing antidepressant efficacy.
action: Monitor for reduced antidepressant effect and consider increasing fluoxetine dose or selecting an alternative antibiotic; fluoxetine concentrations may take 4-6 weeks to stabilize after rifampin initiation or discontinuation.
